text: August exports rose 25% y/y and imports 28.2%, below the 30% estimate. The trade surplus reached $119.09B. U.S.-bound exports rose 34.4%, while domestic demand and investment remained weak.

meta.note: Import and export growth are both elevated, while their relative balance remains asymmetric.

text: Novartis reported a failed Phase III del-desiran trial after pelacarsen missed its endpoint and eight rap-cel trials were paused following three patient deaths. Shares fell 8.9%. Del-desiran entered the pipeline through the $12B Avidity acquisition.

meta.note: The three setbacks span separate programs and therapeutic areas.
